import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem Dummit_Foote_exercise_3_1_22b_mutation {G : Type*} [Group G] (I : Type*) [Nonempty I]
  (H : I → Subgroup G) (hH : ∀ i : I, Normal (H i)) :
  IsGreatest {K : Subgroup G | Normal K ∧ ∀ i : I, K ≤ H i} (iInf H) := by
  constructor
  · refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · constructor
      intro n hn g
      have hn' : ∀ i, n ∈ H i := by
        first
          | exact (Subgroup.mem_iInf.mp hn)
          | exact fun i => (iInf_le (H := H) i) hn
          | exact fun i => SetLike.le_def.mp (iInf_le (H := H) i) hn
          | aesop
      have hg : ∀ i, g * n * g⁻¹ ∈ H i := fun i => by
        first
          | exact (hH i).conj_mem n (hn' i) g
          | haveI : Normal (H i) := hH i
            exact Subgroup.Normal.conj_mem n (hn' i) g
          | aesop
      first
        | exact Subgroup.mem_iInf.mpr hg
        | rw [Subgroup.mem_iInf]; exact hg
        | aesop
    · intro i
      exact iInf_le H i
  · intro K hK
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hK
    obtain ⟨_, hKle⟩ := hK
    exact le_iInf hKle

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem Dummit_Foote_exercise_3_1_22b_mutation {G : Type*} [Group G] (I : Type*) [Nonempty I]
  (H : I → Subgroup G) (hH : ∀ i : I, Normal (H i)) :
  IsGreatest {K : Subgroup G | Normal K ∧ ∀ i : I, K ≤ H i} (iInf H) := by
  have hnormal : Normal (iInf H) :=
    Subgroup.normal_iInf_normal (fun i => hH i)
  have hlower : ∀ i : I, iInf H ≤ H i := by
    intro i
    exact iInf_le H i
  have hmem : iInf H ∈ {K : Subgroup G | Normal K ∧ ∀ i : I, K ≤ H i} := by
    exact ⟨hnormal, hlower⟩
  have hbound : ∀ ⦃K : Subgroup G⦄,
      K ∈ {K : Subgroup G | Normal K ∧ ∀ i : I, K ≤ H i} → K ≤ iInf H := by
    intro K hK
    exact le_iInf (fun i => hK.2 i)
  exact ⟨hmem, hbound⟩
